headlines.title: All-out fight for critical battleground states ramps up
headlines.description: Former President Barack Obama appeared in Ohio Saturday at his first campaign rally for this fall’s midterm elections, hoping to drum up support for Democratic candidates in key battleground races. It comes as the president cast his early ballot on Saturday in Florida. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster reports from battleground Michigan where the former president rallies this evening.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Steve Kornacki on the midterm elections
headlines.description: Election Day is quickly approaching and, with just over a week to go, Steve Kornacki is ready to answer your questions.

headlines.title: Widespread protests expand across Europe as thousands take to streets
headlines.description: Hundreds of thousands of people marched across France on Saturday over school funding and soaring living costs, challenging President Emmanuel Macron’s government in a largely peaceful demonstration before clashes broke out. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports from Paris.

headlines.title: Iranian plots to kill Americans in Middle East have reached ‘advanced stages,’ intel memo warns
headlines.description: Iran has increased efforts to target U.S. personnel in the Middle East and other countries, according to a memo sent by the Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Friday. The memo warned that “the lethal plotting efforts by the Iranians against U.S. citizens have reached advanced stages.” NBC News’ Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: Bulldozers tear down home as Israel cracks down in the West Bank
headlines.description: Bulldozers tore down Palestinian businessman Riyad Mureish’s home in Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday, as Israeli officials launched a fresh crackdown on residents there.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Man with knife arrested near set of ‘Miami Vice ’85’ film starring Michael B. Jordan
headlines.description: A man was arrested Friday night near the Brooklyn set of “Miami Vice ’85,” a film starring Michael B. Jordan and Austin Butler.

headlines.title: Obama describes Trump as an agent of ‘chaos and cruelty’ in midterm elections pitch
headlines.description: Former President Barack Obama characterized President Donald Trump as an agent of “chaos and cruelty” and a man of broken promises during a midterm election rally.

headlines.title: WWE legend Ric Flair recovering after being hospitalized for fall
headlines.description: WWE legend Ric Flair was hospitalized after falling outside of a Florida restaurant while dealing with a blood clot in his leg. The 77-year-old retired American professional wrestler, whose real name is Richard Morgan Fliehr, said in an Instagram post Saturday that he spent the night in a Tampa hospital.
